text:
Maria: Morning all — we need to lock acceptance criteria for the Q3 adaptive-prefetch pilot. Customer must have 99.9% availability, p95 <= 150ms, tenant isolation (VPC), KMS-backed key rotation, and immutable audit logs. Need signoff + sequencing from runtime, infra, and security. Who can own which pieces?

Devon: I can own perf validation. We can hit ~150ms p95 with batching + kv-cache tuning but that depends on quantization and dedicated pool sizing. ETA: 10 days for perf harness + 4 days for quant A/B. Also need infra hooks for cache warmup.

Raj: Infra ok to carve dedicated pool but capacity commit requires sales signoff. Staging slots available Tue/Wed next week. KMS per-tenant will need HSM integration and a cert rotation window.

Toni: From security: KMS + rotation + audit logs are doable but two blockers: (1) HSM cert rotation window needs ops scheduling, (2) we need ACL review for S3 cache dumps. Also require SOC review for pilot — I'll kick that off.

Sam: Owners summary pls: runtime -> perf + fallback, infra -> dedicated pool + autoscale, security -> KMS/HSM + SOC. Product will draft acceptance doc and prompt/eval set. Can everyone drop time estimates and a short canary plan?

Devon: Canary plan: 10% traffic across two AZs, 48h observation window, rollback if p95 regresses >20% or error-rate >2x. Perf validation: 10d harness + 4d quant. I'll post a checklist.

Raj: Provisioning timeline: 3d to carve pool, 2d to test autoscale. I'll open INFRA-5632 and tag @sales-bot for capacity approval. Staging slot requested for Tue 09:00.

Toni: Security timeline: 5d KMS config + 3d HSM cert ops + SOC review (TBD). I'll add required docs to the acceptance doc.

Maria: Action items noted. Product will draft the acceptance doc today and attach the prompt set for quality regressions. If any owner thinks estimates are off, flag now. Otherwise sync tomorrow 10:00.

Lucy: Add monitoring hooks to the acceptance doc: token-level latency breakdown, per-route traces, and an auto-fallback policy (if canary error-rate >2x -> route to secondary region). I'll spin up a Grafana template and alert rules.

Devon: Also: model fallback variants must be evaluated for semantic drift — need small eval harness. I'll add eval scripts to the perf repo.

Maria: sgtm. If perf validation slips beyond 2 weeks we move to a soft-pilot and push full pilot. I'll mark owners in the doc and create follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Raj: INFRA-5632 created and linked. @sales-bot pinged for capacity commitment.

Toni: SOC request filed (SEC-2024). Will update once triage complete.

Maria: Thanks everyone. Quick wins: Devon add checklist, Raj lock staging window, Toni confirm SOC ETA, Lucy add dashboard. See you 10am tomorrow.

Devon: Will post checklist by EOD.

Lucy: Dashboard draft shared in channel — pls review.

sales-bot: Capacity request acknowledged, awaiting purchase order.
